verdict.rationale: Canny's developer docs state that installing its JavaScript SDK identifies users, so feedback they leave is tied to their existing account in your application. Separate doc pages for Single Sign-On and Secure Identify Requests support this flow, though only their titles appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: detailed content on the identify call parameters and secure-identify mechanics (only titles are evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify logged-in users when they submit feedback so it ties to their existing account

citations.quote: Install our JavaScript SDK to identify your users. This way, when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application.
